description: A paved space under the disc: six chrome legs, a lit soffit overhead, open to the weather on all sides. Contractors eat lunch here and Kerbstone Row sheds its rain here. Two legs are worn bare at shoulder height. The soffit lights stay on all day.

window.description: Six of them, between the legs, which is not a window and is how you see out of this room. Standing at the middle you have the row, the lane, Cinder Lane coming down, and the Curtain, in six separate framed slices.
window.name: the open sides

name: The East Lens — The Undercroft
